summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB bundle
details: The package advertises itself as a shared Renovate configuration but ships a preinstall dropper. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is written with hex-mangled identifiers and inline lookup objects that hide its control flow; it downloads the Bun runtime binary v1.3.13 as a zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun-precompiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) constructed as a string-array-shuffle obfuscator (large token array plus a rotator function). A config-sharing package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time and execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle under it; the choice of alternate runtime also evades Node-focused instrumentation. This resolves to attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
